title: UsagePoint
description: A service delivery point — the location and contract at which a utility provides commodity service to a customer. Aligned with the Green Button ESPI UsagePoint concept and broadened to cover gas, water, and steam. UsagePoint is the parent record under which MeterReading and EnergyDataPoint observations are grouped.

id.description: Provider-scoped identifier for this service delivery point.

externalId.description: Utility-side identifier (e.g., service agreement number, account number, SAID, premise ID).

status.description: Lifecycle status of the service delivery point.

customer.description: Customer of record for this UsagePoint. Personally identifiable fields are optional and should only appear with proper authorization.

premise.description: Physical address of the service delivery point.

id.description: Utility identifier in the source system (e.g., NREL URDB utility_id, UtilityAPI utility key).

tariff.description: Active rate plan at the UsagePoint.

meter.description: Physical meter currently associated with the UsagePoint.

ami.description: True if the meter is an Advanced Metering Infrastructure (smart) meter.

der.description: Distributed energy resources installed behind this UsagePoint (PV, storage, EV charger, controllable load).

providerId.description: Identifier of the API or system delivering this UsagePoint record.

authorizationId.description: Identifier for the customer authorization (OAuth grant, signed form, Green Button CMD authorization) under which this record is accessible.
